latestVersion.changelog:
team-video-generation v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches AI-powered collaborative video creation for teams.
- Merges up to five member-recorded clips into a single 1080p MP4 in 1–3 minutes.
- Fully cloud-based workflow; no local setup required.
- Simple authentication with free credits for new users.
- Supports direct user prompts for generating, editing, and exporting videos.
- Accepts common video, image, and audio file formats up to 500MB.
